title: Chapter 123: Territory Guarding Ranking
content:
Chapter 123: Territory Guarding Ranking

Seeing Ayub's expression, Wang Shuo smiled faintly.

Wang Shuo was considering whether to give him soul crystals.

He now has 58 soul crystals.

He has been a little undecided about this matter. It seems that he still needs to find an insider to consult.

"You should study this formation experience carefully and strive to learn it as soon as possible. At the same time, with this legion order, you can form a cavalry unit. I look forward to seeing the invincible style on the battlefield."

Wang Shuo said with expectation, his face full of smiles.

"Yes, I will live up to the trust of the lord." Ayub replied with a firm face.

"Today, you will take some of the combatants of our territory to the ancient battlefield to brush military merit points and strive to brush out the barracks as soon as possible."

"Yes, lord."

Wang Shuo kept Gong Zheng and Li Jianguo.

If there is an emergency, just give Li Jianguo a few assistants to form a powerful firepower.

One has super high defense, the other can use bronze crossbow carts, and with myself, the defense of the territory should be no problem, Wang Shuo thought to himself.

Wang Shuo also planned to let Ayub take the remaining 8 militiamen to gain some combat experience and upgrade their levels.

After Ayub led his men into the portal.

Wang Shuo also found Duan Wenxi and Suo Yong, and the three of them discussed how to carry out the reconstruction of the village.

First of all, the bodies of the beasts must be cleaned up first.

The two acted quickly and organized people to store the bodies of the beasts in different categories.

Wang Shuo took out the village design drawings.

He kept surveying around the territory, and gestured with his hands from time to time.

He frowned from time to time, and smiled from time to time.

At this time, the system prompt sounded.

[The large-scale event "Beast Attacks the Village" has ended. 】

【Rankings now announced (Changping County)】

10th place: Yuehua Village (Zhao Yuehua)

…

6th place: Jiuyang Village (Zhang Yang)

5th place: (Tianba Village) Ye Tianba

…

3rd place: Fengze Village (Zhao Tianze)

2nd place: Jiuyuan Village (Su Xiu)

1st place: Wana Village (Wang Shuo)

As expected, Wang Shuo ranked first.

Unexpectedly, Baiyang Village, which was established first, did not make the list, which made Wang Shuo sigh.

And Jiuyuan Village's ranking did not change much, ranking second.

What surprised Wang Shuo was that Fengze Village actually ranked third.

Wang Shuo became alert. Zhao Tianze from Fengze Village and Wang Shuo had some problems during the novice trial. They were enemies, not friends!

【First place, reward "Skill Proficiency Manual" × 10, a pair of territory guardian beasts (koi), reputation +1000. 】

【Second place, reward: Energy Converter +1, Territory Guardian Beast (Goshawk), Reputation +400. 】

…

A fish tank icon suddenly appeared in Wang Shuo's backpack.

After taking it out, two golden fish swam freely in the water in a fish tank.

【Koi: Territory Guardian Beast, Juvenile Stage, Characteristics: 1. Good weather, the probability of natural disasters in the territory is reduced by 1%. 2. Good harvest, increase the yield of crops in the territory by 5%, and shorten the growth cycle by 2%. 】

Wang Shuo looked at the fish in front of him and treasured it very much.

He took out another thing, the "Skill Proficiency Manual".

Wang Shuo found that each book can improve skill proficiency. He thought about it and thought that this kind of thing can be used to improve skill level at critical times.
